name: b(l)ackhome Boutique
beschreibung: The b(l)ackhome Boutique is a hotel in the state of Tirol. The accommodation features a modern and individual design concept. Guests can choose from various room categories that are stylishly furnished. The hotel offers amenities such as a wellness area and dining. The location in Tirol allows for excursions into the surrounding mountains and valleys. The property places value on a personal and relaxed atmosphere. It is aimed at travelers who value aesthetically pleasing accommodations. The concept combines comfort with regional influences.
